nodes.long_description:
1. Put the periodic table in the correct position 
2. Combine molecules to make a new molecule 
3. Put the elements in the measuring instrument
nodes.short_description:
In virtual reality, you insert the periodic table in the right place and combine molecules to create new molecules 
to be able to find out information by using a measuring instrument
